opening: What if the Ad never took the game away?
If the broadcast keeps going, so does the viewer.
More room to advertise. Fewer reasons to leave.

beats.text: In this soccer match the hydration break is about to start.
A concurrentInterstitial is inserted, signalling four Ad opportunities during the hydration break.
The first Ad is an image, a transparent PNG.
The second Ad is a video in an L-SHAPE. The picture folds into a corner and the Ad takes the L.
Full-screen Ads can live here too, the interstitials we are used to today.
And back. Sixty-four seconds of advertising in one stoppage, and nobody was given a reason to look away.
